subject_lessons.title: Y4 Math: Angles (Acute, Right, Obtuse) & Decimal Tenths/Hundredths
subject_lessons.story:
TRADITIONAL MATH LESSON (GRADE 4):
• Angles measure how much a line turns in degrees (°):
  - Acute Angle: smaller than 90° (like our Lidar beams at 30° and 60°!)
  - Right Angle: a square corner of exactly 90°
  - Obtuse Angle: between 90° and 180°
• Decimals: 0.25 is 2 tenths + 5 hundredths (25/100 or 1/4).

# 📐 YEAR 4 MATH ASSIGNMENT: Classifying Lidar Beam Angles
angles_deg = [30, 60, 90, 120]
for a in angles_deg:
    kind = 'Acute' if a < 90 else ('Right' if a == 90 else 'Obtuse')
    print(f'{a:3d} degrees -> {kind} Angle')

subject_lessons.title: Y4 Science: Light Waves, Laser Reflection & Kinetic vs. Potential Energy
subject_lessons.story:
TRADITIONAL SCIENCE LESSON (GRADE 4):
• Light & Lasers travel in straight waves until they bounce off an obstacle (Reflection). Lidar (Light Detection and Ranging) measures how far away a wall is using 5 laser beams!
• Potential Energy is stored energy (a rocket high in the sky); Kinetic Energy is energy of motion (a fast racecar).

subject_lessons.title: Y4 Reading & Writing: Nonfiction Summaries, Similes & Metaphors
subject_lessons.story:
TRADITIONAL LANGUAGE ARTS LESSON (GRADE 4):
• A Simile compares two things using 'like' or 'as': "The Lidar beams swept the road like a lighthouse."
• A Metaphor compares directly: "The neural network is the driver's brain."
• Writing a Summary: State the main idea + 2 key supporting facts in your own words.

subject_lessons.coding_challenge:
# 🤖 YEAR 4 AI CAPSTONE: Lidar Sensor Sweep in Python
from workbench.labs.raycast_car import NEATRaycastCarLab

for rng in [60.0, 120.0, 180.0]:
    lab = NEATRaycastCarLab()
    lab.update_param('sensor_range', rng)
    t = lab.fast_forward_generations(5)
    print(f"Lidar Range {rng:5.1f}px -> Best Score: {t['best_ever']:6.1f}")
